title: Fence Stretcher / Wire Tensioner – Heavy-Duty for Garden & Pasture
descriptionHtml:
Impossible to get the fence wire really tight?

Pulling fence wire tight by hand is heavy, slippery and usually ends with a slack line that sags after the first winter. A loose fence means animals on the run and constant repairs.

Tighten the wire rock hard – with leverage

The heavy-duty tensioner gives you the leverage to pull the fence wire really tight and lock it in place. The result is a sturdy, evenly tensioned fence around the whole garden or pasture – that lasts season after season.

Features

  • Strong leverage – tightens the wire hard without hand strength.
  • Durable construction – withstands heavy use.
  • For garden and pasture fences.
  • Stable grip – doesn't slip under tension.
